doi_hinh_dang_khi_NAP.ipv4Settings: lay tu ban ghi wan: protocol, gateway, ipAddress, mask, pppoe; dns={autoDnsEnabled: autoDnsEnabled?'auto':'manual', dnsServers:{primary:dnsServers[0]||'', secondary:dnsServers[1]||''}}
doi_hinh_dang_khi_NAP.ipv6Settings: lay tu ban ghi wan6: protocol = (slaacEnabled && protocol==='dhcpv6') ? 'slaac' : protocol; ipAddress, gateway, prefix; dns nhu tren
doi_hinh_dang_khi_NAP.ipVersion: SUY RA: ipv4.enabled && !ipv6.enabled -> '4'; !ipv4.enabled && ipv6.enabled -> '6'; con lai -> '10'

1_goc: usage===Backup -> hien cong tac 'Enable backup Internet' (name='enabled'). Tab Internet KHONG co cong tac nay.
(enabled || usage===Internet) -> hien nhom radio ipVersion (IPv4 & IPv6 / IPv4 / IPv6), bay ngang (MenuProps row)
enabled=false -> AN toan bo phan con lai (cong vat ly, MTU, IPv4, IPv6, VLAN)
4_trong_khoi_IPv4 (ht): protocol==='static' -> hien 'IPv4 Static IP' + 'IPv4 Subnet Mask' + 'IPv4 Gateway Address'
protocol==='dhcp' -> khong hien them o nao
5_trong_khoi_IPv6 (St): luon: Select 'Connection Type' voi 3 tuy chon NHAN KHAC gia tri: 'DHCPv6 (Stateful)'=dhcpv6, 'DHCPv6 (Stateless)'=slaac, 'Static'=static
tuy chon 'Static' bi VO HIEU HOA khi: ipv4 dang bat (enabled && ipVersion thuoc {4,10}) VA ipv4 protocol==='pppoe'
protocol==='static' -> hien 'IPv6 WAN Address' + 'IPv6 Gateway Address' + 'Custom Delegated IPv6-Prefix' (goi y: 'e.g., 2001:0db8:85a3::/64')
6_khoi_DNS (Ne, dung chung cho ca IPv4 v: protocol==='static' -> AN nhom radio (vi bi ep sang Manual, xem rang buoc lien dong)
dns.autoDnsEnabled==='manual' -> hien 'Primary DNS' + 'Secondary DNS (Optional)'; co lop 'manualInputs' (thut le) khi protocol!=='static'
7_khoi_VLAN (xt): vlan.enabled && ipv4 dang bat && ipv4 protocol==='dhcp' -> hien nhom radio Automatic/Manual (name='vlan.autoDetectionEnabled')
vlan.enabled && vlan.autoDetectionEnabled==='manual' -> hien o 'VLAN ID' (so, 1..4094, goi y 'Range: 1 to 4094.'); co lop 'manualInputs' khi ipv4 protocol==='dhcp'

rang_buoc_lien_dong (watch effect): doi ipv4 protocol sang 'static' ma DNS dang 'auto' -> EP dns.autoDnsEnabled='manual'
doi ipv6 protocol sang 'static' ma DNS dang 'auto' -> EP dns.autoDnsEnabled='manual'
doi ipVersion/enabled/ipv4 protocol: neu (ipv4 KHONG bat HOAC protocol!=='dhcp') va vlan.autoDetectionEnabled==='auto' -> EP vlan.autoDetectionEnabled='manual'
neu ipv4 bat + protocol==='pppoe' + ipv6 bat + ipv6 protocol==='static' -> EP ipv6 protocol='dhcpv6' (khong cho Static IPv6 khi IPv4 chay PPPoE)
